title: Labyrinth
statement: You are given a map of a labyrinth, and your task is to find a path from start to end. You can walk left, right, up and down.
inputFormat:
The first input line has two integers $n$ and $m$: the height and width of the map.
Then there are $n$ lines of $m$ characters describing the labyrinth. Each character is `.` (floor), `#` (wall), `A` (start), or `B` (end).
outputFormat:
First print "YES", if there is a path, and "NO" otherwise.
If there is a path, print the length of the shortest such path and its description as a string consisting of characters `L` (left), `R` (right), `U` (up), and `D` (down).
